blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Metropolitan Manila Development Authority (MMDA) has temporarily suspended all road excavations in national and city roads in Metro Manila. The suspension is meant to avoid worsening the expected heavy traffic congestion to be brought by the Christmas season. In an advisory on Saturday (October 31), the MMDA said that the temporary suspension of road works will take effect on Sunday (November 1) at 12 a.m. It will last until December 23 at 12 a.m. “This is intended to minimize disruptions and ensure a smoother journey for motorists, given the expected increase in the number of vehicles as […]...
